entries.title: Knowt
entries.text: Learn more about Knowt, our schoolʻs new Quizlet replacement, today, Mon, 11/10, lunch at the Digital Literacy Ambassadors meeting in SCIL 403. Free snacks for all attendees! Also come by to learn more about the DLAʻs Clearspace Challenge mentioned in the SAO. Complete the challenge and enter to win a free winterball bid, a pro kendama, and other fun raffle prizes.

entries.title: Spring Musical Auditions
entries.text: HADESTOWN. Auditions this Thurs 11/12 and Fri Nov 12, 3:15-5:30. Performance Dates are Feb 18, 19, and 20, 2027. Rehearsals begin Mon, Nov 30, and run Monday-Friday from 3:15-5:30. No rehearsals over Winter Break. Questions contact: asakaguchi@iolani.org or mchicks@iolani.org Audition Registration Form Link: https://forms.gle/Kg3TL2Zc8h24htWW9 Audition Materials: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1JrWtv2_umjiZY3qbBTUUSHVfWZ49Gsu7?usp=sharing

entries.title: Orchestra Performance
entries.text: Don't miss the Orchestra 4 & 5 performance on Saturday, Nov. 14 at 7 p.m. at the beautiful Moanalua High School Performing Arts Center. Click to purchase tickets ($5) online. We are positive you will enjoy the scintillating sounds of strings presenting music by well-known composers including: Tchaikovsky, Dvraok, Mozart, Paganini, Grainger, and more. This concert features the first of our senior Concerto Competition winners -- Christopher Oyama '27 performing the exciting Violin Concerto by Jean Sibelius, Mvt III -- and also includes musicians from our Band program to create the ‘Iolani Symphony Orchestra.

entries.title: Future Business Leaders of America
entries.text: FBLA is excited to announce our upcoming school conference on Nov 24, with the award ceremony on Nov 25! Students can compete in a variety of events, with overall top scorers receiving a $50 gift card and finalists earning medals and certificates. ALL (you do not need to be in FBLA) interested students are encouraged to register and showcase their skills. Please register using this link by Nov 15: https://forms.gle/CzYHhN7MZPiWEwkw9 Please contact klp2801@iolani.org or ec2801@iolani.org for more information.

entries.title: Sons and Daughters
entries.text: SDI Photo TODAY, Mon, Nov 9, during homeroom. Go to LS Autoline Monkeypod after attendance. GRADES 9-12--FOOD4THOUGHT: STUDENTS AS PRODUCERS! We’re focusing on the Food Cycle for this year’s Food4Thought series, and our first spotlight is on PRODUCTION. Connect with ʻāina and help feed your community! Watch this video (~3:30) for ways you can volunteer with singer Jack Johnsonʻs Kōkua Foundation.

entries.title: Homerooms
entries.text: PSAT RESULTS! Watch this PSAT Results Video while your teacher passes back your PSAT score reports. Students may also access their recent PSAT scores by logging into their College Board account at studentscores.collegeboard.org. Freshmen and Sophomores will need to create a College Board account if they have not done so already. Email jandrews@iolani.org with any questions. GRADES 7-8--FOOD4THOUGHT: GROW A SOLUTION!: We’re focusing on the Food Cycle for this year’s Food4Thought series, and our first spotlight is on PRODUCTION. Our Lower School grows and harvests food in its gardens, but did you know that you can help grow food in the Upper School, too? To be part of this new initiative, or to volunteer for an upcoming Lower School harvest, contact Ms. Sakuda in the C+CE Office!
